    LaTeX source
    \begin{theorem}[signed read-$k$ Fourier entropy--influence]\label{thm:main}
\lean{FEI.SignedReadKAssembly.signed_readk_exact_fei}
\leanok
\uses{lem:absorb,prop:unate,lem:polarity,lem:readone}
Every signed read-$k$ DNF or CNF, \(k\ge2\), satisfies
\[
 H(f)\le\bigl[8+K(T_{2k-1}+T_k)\bigr]I(f)\le24kI(f).
\]
At read two,
\[
 H(f)\le\left[8+\frac{216}{13\ln2}\right]I(f)\le32I(f).
\]
The rounded inequalities are strict for nonconstant functions, and read one
has coefficient eight.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
Capture unate coordinates and apply \cref{lem:absorb} with the constant from
\cref{prop:unate}; optimizing \(p(1-p)^{k-1}\) at \(p=1/k\) adds \(KT_k\).
The manuscript proves \(T_a<ea\), \(Ke<8\), and the sharper read-two scalar
bound by elementary series estimates.  De Morgan duality transfers the DNF
result to CNFs.
\end{proof}

    Remark: Every clause of the node is proved, including the strictness and the CNF half. The node has more than one conclusion; \lean{} names the principal declaration because the page generator resolves a single name, and the statement below names the rest. Lean statement: The node makes four claims and each has its own proved theorem, all axiom-clean and all in lean/fei_read_k_signed_readtwo_assembly.lean. The exact coefficient 8 + K*(T_(2k-1) + T_k) is signed_readk_exact_fei, proving UNPROVED_signed_readk_exact_fei; the rounded 24k is signed_readk_linear_fei, proving UNPROVED_signed_readk_linear_fei; the read-two coefficient 8 + 216/(13 log 2) is signed_readtwo_short_fei, proving UNPROVED_signed_readtwo_short_fei. The claim that the ROUNDED inequalities are strict for nonconstant functions is signed_readk_linear_strict and signed_readtwo_strict, nonconstancy entering as 0 < totalInfluence; it is a separate claim from the non-strict Props and is not implied by them, so it is named separately. The claim that the theorem covers signed read-k CNFs as well as DNFs is the three _cnf theorems, by De Morgan: a signed read-k CNF is the negation of a signed read-k DNF display, and both sides of FEI are invariant under a global sign flip -- influence because the discrete derivative only changes sign, entropy because the spectral law is built from SQUARED Fourier coefficients (specEnt_neg). The remaining clause, that read one has coefficient eight, is lem:readone's own node. No clause of this node is carried by prose.

    Definition · def:setting · blueprint/src/closed_case_read_k_short_capture_body.tex:11
    LaTeX source
    \begin{definition}[signed read-$k$ display]\label{def:setting}
\lean{FEI.UnateRT2.Display}
\leanok
A signed DNF display is
\(f=2\mathbf 1[\bigvee_jT_j]-1\) on the uniform Boolean cube.  Its read is
at most \(k\) when every coordinate occurs in at most \(k\) displayed terms,
counting labels rather than distinct supports. A display is positive when
all its literals are positive, and unate when each coordinate occurs with
at most one polarity. Flipping input signs makes a unate display positive
without changing its entropy or influences.
Write \(X\) for the spectral sample with law \(\widehat f^{\,2}\),
\(H(f)=H(X)\), \(I_i(f)=\Pr[f(x)\ne f(x\oplus e_i)]\),
\(I_A(f)=\sum_{i\in A}I_i(f)\), \(I(f)=I_{[n]}(f)\), \(K=2/\ln2\), and
\[
  T_a=\frac{a^a}{(a-1)^{a-1}}\qquad(a\ge2).
\]
Actual restrictions delete falsified terms, erase fixed satisfied literals,
and, when required, remove subsumed surviving terms, keeping the first of
equal terms in a fixed order. A \(p\)-restriction, \(0<p<1\),
draws a retained set \(L\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\}\), each coordinate
independently with probability \(p\), and freezes \(L^c\) to the
coordinates of a uniform input \(x\) drawn independently of \(L\); the
function it leaves is \(g\), whose free coordinates are
\(\operatorname{Free}(g)=L\); some of these coordinates may have zero
influence. Each capture rule below selects
\(U(g)\subseteq\operatorname{Free}(g)\) deterministically from the
specified inherited display. Every fixing of
\(\operatorname{Free}(g)\setminus U(g)\) leaves a function in the simpler
class used by that rule; \(g\) itself need not belong to that class.
\end{definition}

Lean statement: FEI.UnateRT2.Display is the signed DNF display: a structure carrying the supports V j and the polarities eps j of s terms, which is exactly the object this node introduces. The same declaration backs def:display of the unate read-two closed case, whose paragraph has the same shape -- it defines the display, the read-k property and further notation in one environment. This case refers to it through the abbreviation FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display. Each remaining item the paragraph fixes has its own declaration, and none is carried by prose: the presented function f = 2*[OR of terms] - 1 is FEI.UnateRT2.Display.signOf (defined as 1 - 2*Hnf); the read bound "every coordinate occurs in at most k displayed terms" is (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.incident D i).card <= k, which is how all eight UNPROVED_ Props of this case state it; H(f) is FEI.PrivateCore.specEnt and I(f) is FEI.totalInfluence; T_a is FEI.ShortReadKCapture.transferFactor, and K = 2/log 2 appears inline throughout rather than as a named constant. The restriction semantics -- delete falsified terms, erase fixed satisfied literals, and remove subsumed surviving terms -- is FEI.PrivateCore.restr together with FEI.SignedRT2.Restrict.exists_restricted_display, which produces the display on the surviving terms with supports shortened to V j minus the frozen set, and, for the subsumption-normalised form Proposition 6 needs, FEI.ReadKUnate.exists_minimal_display over FEI.ShortReadKCapture.minimalLabels.

    (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Bool) ≃ Finset (Fin n)
    noncomputable def maskEquiv (n : ℕ) : (Fin n → Bool) ≃ Finset (Fin n) where
  toFun := retained
  invFun L := fun i => decide (i ∈ L)
  left_inv := by
    intro mask
    funext i
    by_cases h : mask i = true
    · simp [retained, h]
    · simp [retained, h, by simpa using h]
  right_inv := by
    intro L
    ext i
    simp [retained]

/-! ## 3. `prop_extremal` and `lem_disjoint`, `hused`-free and tautology-safe

Both class theorems are restated for a `Display`, with **neither** `hused` nor
the falsifiability hypothesis: `hused` is discharged by the reduction of §2, and
the tautological case -- the one the restriction bridge's trichotomy does not
detect -- is closed inside, by `FEI.SignedRT2.Restrict.const_fei`. A consumer
therefore applies these to the bridge's third branch with nothing left over. -/

    Full elaborated type
    {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → Bool) ≃ (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → Bool)
    def mixEquiv (rho : Fin n → Bool) :
    ((Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → Bool)) ≃ ((Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → Bool)) where
  toFun p := (mix rho p.1 p.2, mix rho p.2 p.1)
  invFun q := (mix rho q.1 q.2, mix rho q.2 q.1)
  left_inv p := by
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
    have h := mix_involutive rho a b
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2⟩
  right_inv q := by
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := q
    have h := mix_involutive rho a b
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2⟩

    FEI.of · lean/fei_part_a_equivalence.lean:751

    Explicit hypotheses: not checked for this source version.

    class of Part A.  Three statements, carried here in the order the manuscript
proves them:

* `lem:derivative-coefficient` — `|f̂(T ∪ {k})| ≤ Infₖ(f)`;
* `prop:spectral-norm-coordinate` — `Qₖ(f) ≤ Infₖ(f)·‖f̂‖₁`, in the
  edge-affinity normalisation `2Qₖ = edgeAffinity`;
* `thm:bounded-spectral-norm` — the folded certificate `SEᵢ ≤ 2‖f̂‖₁·θ̃ᵢ` at
  *every* coordinate, restriction and character stability of `‖f̂‖₁ ≤ A`, and
  the class constant `2A + 2log₂e` with its unconditional specialisation
  `A = ‖f̂‖₁`.

The class conclusion consumes the class-relative form of the restriction
induction — the reverse implication of `thm:one-good-coordinate` run inside a
restriction-stable class, which is the step `thm:bounded-spectral-norm`(iii)
and `thm:bounded-algebraic-degree`(iii) both invoke.  It is proved below as
`localSelection_class_implies_FEI`; `partA_localSelection_implies_FEI` is its
`P = fun _ => True` instance.  It is *not* `prop:class-transfer`, which runs
the other way, from a class FEI constant to a local certificate.

Not formalised, and deliberately: the comparison of
`rem:spectral-norm-comparison`, that Rényi monotonicity gives
`H[f] ≤ 2log₂‖f̂‖₁` for free and beats the boxed bound unless the influence is
small.  What is proved here is the FEI *form* and the per-coordinate
uniformity. -/

    238. cube logarithmic Sobolev inequality Blueprint: statement and proof \leanok

    Blueprint

    Lemma · lem:cube-lsi · blueprint/src/closed_case_read_k_short_capture_body.tex:55
    LaTeX source
    \begin{lemma}[cube logarithmic Sobolev inequality]\label{lem:cube-lsi}
\lean{FEI.WidthBand.cube_log_sobolev}
\leanok
For every real-valued function \(h\) on a uniform Boolean cube, with
\(\operatorname{Ent}(v)=\E(v\log_2v)-(\E v)\log_2(\E v)\),
\[
 \operatorname{Ent}(h^2)\le\frac{2}{\ln2}\sum_u |u|\,\widehat h(u)^2.
\]
This is the cited inequality in bits and Fourier form, obtained by dividing
by \(\ln2\) and applying Parseval. The manuscript quotes it; the Lean
counterpart proves it.
\literature{M.~Ledoux, \emph{Concentration of measure and logarithmic Sobolev inequalities}, S\'eminaire de Probabilit\'es 33 (1999), 120--216}{Section~2.2, Eq.~(2.14) and its product-space extension}
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
\leanok
For the uniform two-point law, the proved two-point estimate is
\[
 \operatorname{Ent}_{\{0,1\}}(a^2,b^2)
 \le \frac{(a-b)^2}{2\ln2}.
\]
Entropy tensorization bounds \(\operatorname{Ent}(h^2)\) by the sum,
over coordinates, of the expected two-point entropies of its fibers.
Apply the displayed bound with \(a=h(x)\) and \(b=h(x^{(i)})\).
Since \(D_i h(x)=(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))/2\), the result is
\((2/\ln2)\sum_i\E(D_i h)^2\). Parseval identifies the last sum with
\(\sum_u |u|\widehat h(u)^2\), proving the claim.
The two-point estimate, tensorization, and Parseval are themselves proved
in the Lean dependencies of the displayed declaration.
\end{proof}

    Remark: Source: M. Ledoux, Concentration of measure and logarithmic Sobolev inequalities, Séminaire de Probabilités 33 (1999), 120–216, Section 2.2, Eq. (2.14) and its product-space extension.     theorem cube_log_sobolev (g : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) :
    Ent (fun x => g x ^ 2)
      ≤ (2 / Real.log 2)
        * ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (S.card : ℝ) * FEI.fourierCoeff g S ^ 2 := by
  have hlog2 : (0:ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hstep : ∀ i : Fin n,
      entOver {i} (fun x => g x ^ 2) ≤ (2 / Real.log 2) * FEI.influenceOf g i := by
    intro i
    rw [entOver_singleton_eq]
    have hle : ∀ x : Fin n → Bool,
        FEI.PrivateCore.entTwo (g x ^ 2) (g (FEI.flipAt x i) ^ 2)
          ≤ (2 / Real.log 2) * FEI.deriv i g x ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      have h := FEI.PrivateCore.two_point_ent_le (g x) (g (FEI.flipAt x i))
      have heq : (g x - g (FEI.flipAt x i)) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.log 2)
          = (2 / Real.log 2) * FEI.deriv i g x ^ 2 := by
        unfold FEI.deriv
        field_simp
      rw [heq] at h
      exact h
    refine le_trans (expect_mono hle) ?_
    rw [expect_mul_const]
    rfl
  calc Ent (fun x => g x ^ 2)
      = entOver (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) (fun x => g x ^ 2) :=
        (entOver_univ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)), entOver {i} (fun x => g x ^ 2) :=
        entOver_le_sum (fun x => by positivity) _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)),
          (2 / Real.log 2) * FEI.influenceOf g i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hstep i)
    _ = (2 / Real.log 2) * FEI.totalInfluence g := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; rfl
    _ = (2 / Real.log 2)
          * ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (S.card : ℝ) * FEI.fourierCoeff g S ^ 2 := by
        rw [FEI.totalInfluence_eq_sum_card]

/-! ## 5. The influence-paid divergence bound

`FEI.PrivateCore.DivergenceBound` was the second `Prop` PR #579 carried.  It is
a theorem here, from `cube_log_sobolev`.

The step that would otherwise need heavy Fourier index bookkeeping --- summing
`∑_u |u| ĝ_T(u)²` over the core alphabet `T` --- is done instead by Plancherel
in the core variable and the gluing reindexing, which turns it into an ordinary
influence of `f`. -/

section Divergence

variable {n : ℕ}

open FEI.PrivateCore

    Remark: The manuscript quotes this classical input; the existing Lean theorem proves it by the two-point estimate and tensorization. Lean statement: For every natural number n and every real-valued function h on the uniform Boolean cube (Fin n -> Bool), FEI.WidthBand.cube_log_sobolev bounds Ent(h squared) by (2 / log 2) times the sum over all coordinate subsets S of card(S) times the squared Fourier coefficient of h at S. Ent is E(v log_2 v) - E(v) log_2 E(v). The theorem has no Boolean-valuedness or normalization hypothesis and exactly matches the cited input in bits and Fourier form. In lean/fei_width_band_entropy_inputs.lean.

    Lemma · lem:reconstruction · blueprint/src/closed_case_read_k_short_capture_body.tex:96
    LaTeX source
    \begin{lemma}[restriction reconstruction]\label{lem:reconstruction}
\lean{FEI.ReadKLemma1Absorb.restriction_reconstruction}
\leanok
\uses{def:setting,lem:cube-lsi}
For a coordinate block \(A\), its complement \(B\), and the actual
restrictions \(f_z\),
\[
 \E_z I(f_z)=I_A(f),\qquad H(X_A)\le \E_zH(f_z)+K I_B(f).
\]
Consequently a \(p\)-restriction \(g\) satisfies
\[
 \E I(g)=pI(f),\qquad
 H(f)\le p^{-1}\E H(g)+K(1-p)p^{-1}I(f),
\]
and for every partition into coordinate blocks \(U,M\),
\[
 H(f)\le\E_{z_M}H(f_{z_M})+\E_{z_U}H(f_{z_U})+KI(f),
\]
where \(f_{z_M}\) fixes \(M\) and \(f_{z_U}\) fixes \(U\).
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
Expand restricted Fourier coefficients, express the entropy defect as a sum
of entropy functionals, and apply the cube logarithmic Sobolev inequality
of Lemma~\ref{lem:cube-lsi}. The random and two-block forms follow from the entropy chain
rule and subadditivity.
\end{proof}

    theorem restriction_reconstruction (f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : FEI.IsBoolean f)
    (A : Finset (Fin n)) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    -- (i) fixed-block influence identity
    ((FEI.expect fun z => FEI.totalInfluence (restr Aᶜ f z))
        = ∑ i ∈ A, FEI.influenceOf f i)
    -- (ii) fixed-block entropy bound
    ∧ (FEI.CondInfo.entropyOf (FEI.spectralProb f) (fun S => S ∩ A)
        ≤ (FEI.expect fun z => PrivateCore.specEnt (restr Aᶜ f z))
          + (2 / Real.log 2) * ∑ i ∈ Aᶜ, FEI.influenceOf f i)
    -- (iii) the p-restriction influence identity
    ∧ ((∑ mask : Fin n → Bool, maskWeight p mask *
          FEI.expect fun z => FEI.totalInfluence (restr (frozen mask) f z))
        = p * FEI.totalInfluence f)
    -- (iv) the p-restriction reconstruction inequality
    ∧ (PrivateCore.specEnt f
        ≤ p⁻¹ * (∑ mask : Fin n → Bool, maskWeight p mask *
              FEI.expect fun z => PrivateCore.specEnt (restr (frozen mask) f z))
          + (2 / Real.log 2) * (1 - p) * p⁻¹ * FEI.totalInfluence f)
    -- (v) the two-block reconstruction inequality
    ∧ (PrivateCore.specEnt f
        ≤ ((FEI.expect fun z => PrivateCore.specEnt (restr Aᶜ f z))
            + FEI.expect fun z => PrivateCore.specEnt (restr A f z))
          + (2 / Real.log 2) * FEI.totalInfluence f) :=
  ⟨FEI.RestrEntropy.expect_influence_fixed A f,
   FEI.RestrEntropy.fixed_block_le A f,
   FEI.ReadKRestr.expect_influence_bernoulli f p,
   FEI.ReadKRestr.bernoulli_reconstruction f hf hp0 hp1,
   FEI.RestrEntropy.two_block_reconstruction f hf A⟩

/-! ## 2. Lemma 3, over a restriction-closed class

The class is a predicate `C`; `R` is its extremal ratio, given by the two
properties the manuscript actually uses -- that it bounds every member, and
that some member attains it.  `EH`, `EIU`, `EIM` are the mask-averaged
entropy and the captured and mixed influences of a member.  No structure is
assumed of them beyond the four hypotheses the manuscript lists. -/

    Remark: All five clauses of the node in one theorem. Lean statement: FEI.ReadKLemma1Absorb.restriction_reconstruction states the node's five clauses as one conjunction: the fixed-block influence identity E_z I(f_z) = I_A(f) (FEI.RestrEntropy.expect_influence_fixed); the fixed-block entropy bound H(X_A) <= E_z H(f_z) + K I_(A complement)(f) (FEI.RestrEntropy.fixed_block_le); the p-restriction influence identity E I(g) = p I(f) (FEI.ReadKRestr.expect_influence_bernoulli); the p-restriction reconstruction inequality H(f) <= p inverse times E H(g) + K(1-p)/p times I(f) (FEI.ReadKRestr.bernoulli_reconstruction); and the two-block inequality (FEI.RestrEntropy.two_block_reconstruction). Each conjunct is exactly the named library theorem, so the declaration proves no new mathematics -- it supplies the single statement the node asserts, which the library previously had only in five pieces across two namespaces.     240. cube edge-isoperimetric inequality Blueprint: statement and proof \leanok

    Blueprint

    Lemma · lem:cube-isoperimetry · blueprint/src/closed_case_read_k_short_capture_body.tex:136
    LaTeX source
    \begin{lemma}[cube edge-isoperimetric inequality]\label{lem:cube-isoperimetry}
\lean{FEI.WidthBand.influence_ge_level}
\leanok
Let \(f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}\), and let its negative level set
\(A=\{x:f(x)=-1\}\) be nonempty. Then
\[
 2\frac{|A|}{2^n}\log_2\frac{2^n}{|A|}\le I(f).
\]
The cited theorem uses the smaller level-set probability. Its consequence
for either level follows from
\((1-t)\log_2(1/(1-t))\ge t\log_2(1/t)\) for \(t>1/2\).
The positive level follows by replacing \(f\) by \(-f\).
The manuscript quotes this classical input; the Lean counterpart proves it.
\literature{R.~O'Donnell, \emph{Analysis of Boolean Functions}, Cambridge University Press (2014)}{Theorem~2.39, p.~52}
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
\leanok
Let \(b(A)\) count edges with one endpoint in \(A\) and the other outside.
The verified sharp edge-isoperimetric theorem gives
\(b(A)\ge |A|(n-\log_2|A|)\). For a Boolean sign function, the
squared discrete derivative is exactly the indicator of disagreement on
the corresponding edge. Summing over coordinates and vertices counts each
boundary edge twice, so \(I(f)=2b(A)/2^n\). Consequently
\[
 I(f)\ge\frac{2|A|}{2^n}(n-\log_2|A|)
       =2\frac{|A|}{2^n}\log_2\frac{2^n}{|A|}.
\]
The sharp boundary theorem is proved in the pinned InformationTheory
package; the edge-count identity and the normalization above are proved
by the named Lean declaration and its dependencies.
\end{proof}

    theorem influence_ge_level (f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : FEI.IsBoolean f)
    {A : Finset (Fin n → Bool)} (hA : A.Nonempty)
    (hmem : ∀ x, f x = -1 ↔ x ∈ A) :
    2 * ((A.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) * Real.logb 2 ((2:ℝ) ^ n / (A.card : ℝ))
      ≤ FEI.totalInfluence f := by
  have hcard : (0:ℝ) < (A.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hA
  have hpow : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ n := by positivity
  have hiso := EXT_edgeBoundary_entropy_sharp hA
  have hlog2 : Real.logb 2 (2:ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.logb, div_self (ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)))]
  have hpown : Real.logb 2 ((2:ℝ) ^ n) = (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.logb_pow, hlog2, mul_one]
  have hlog : Real.logb 2 ((2:ℝ) ^ n / (A.card : ℝ))
      = (n : ℝ) - Real.logb 2 (A.card : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.logb_div (ne_of_gt hpow) (ne_of_gt hcard), hpown]
  have key : 2 * ((A.card : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - Real.logb 2 (A.card : ℝ)))
      ≤ 2 * (edgeBoundaryCount A : ℝ) := by linarith [hiso]
  rw [totalInfluence_eq_edgeBoundary hf hmem, hlog]
  calc 2 * ((A.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) * ((n : ℝ) - Real.logb 2 (A.card : ℝ))
      = (2 * ((A.card : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - Real.logb 2 (A.card : ℝ)))) / 2 ^ n := by
        ring
    _ ≤ (2 * (edgeBoundaryCount A : ℝ)) / 2 ^ n :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right key hpow.le

    Lemma · lem:absorb · blueprint/src/closed_case_read_k_short_capture_body.tex:204
    LaTeX source
    \begin{lemma}[capture and absorption]\label{lem:absorb}
\lean{FEI.ReadKLemma1Absorb.absorb_of_class}
\leanok
\uses{lem:reconstruction}
Let \(\mathcal C\) be a class of Boolean functions closed under actual
restriction, and fix \(0<p<1\), \(A\ge0\), and \(\delta>0\).
After a \(p\)-restriction and a specified normalization of its inherited
display, suppose one can choose
\(U(g)\subseteq\operatorname{Free}(g)\) such that every fixing of
\(\operatorname{Free}(g)\setminus U(g)\) has entropy at most \(A\) times
its influence, and
\(\E I_{U(g)}(g)\ge p\delta I(f)\) for every \(f\in\mathcal C\).
Then every \(f\in\mathcal C\) satisfies
\[
 H(f)\le\left(A+\frac{K}{p\delta}\right)I(f).
\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
For a fixed dimension bound \(n\), maximize \(H/I\) over the nonconstant
members of \(\mathcal C\) on at most \(n\) coordinates. This maximum
\(R\) is finite; if \(R\le A\) the conclusion is immediate. Otherwise
choose a maximizer \(f\). For each fixed \(g\), two-block reconstruction
and restriction closure give
\(H(g)\le(R+K)I(g)-(R-A)I_{U(g)}(g)\).
The partition is chosen after \(g\), so no independence of \(U(g)\) and
\(g\) is needed. Average, use \(\E I(g)=pI(f)\), and insert random
reconstruction to obtain \(\delta(R-A)\le K/p\). The resulting bound
does not depend on \(n\); constant functions have \(H=I=0\).
\end{proof}

    \begin{lemma}[$k$-read capture]\label{lem:kcapture}
\lean{FEI.ReadKLemma4.coordinatewise_readk_capture}
\leanok
\uses{def:setting}
For every positive display, every coordinate \(i\) of read \(r_i\ge1\), and
every \(p\in(0,1)\), subsumption-normalized \(p\)-restrictions satisfy
\[
 \E\!\left[\mathbf 1_{\{i\in U(g)\}}I_i(g)\right]
 \ge p(1-p)^{2(r_i-1)}I_i(f),
\]
where \(U(g)\subseteq\operatorname{Free}(g)\) consists of the free
coordinates occurring in at most one surviving minimal term.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
At a true pivotal input, use the first firing term of minimum width.  A
source-recovery lowering map proves that the mean number of required frozen
coordinates is at most \(2(r_i-1)\).  Freezing those coordinates leaves one
minimal incident term, and Jensen's inequality gives the displayed capture
probability.
\end{proof}

    Lemma · lem:onecapture · blueprint/src/closed_case_read_k_short_capture_body.tex:283
    LaTeX source
    \begin{lemma}[read-one capture at read two]\label{lem:onecapture}
\lean{FEI.ReadKCapture.coordinatewise_readone_capture}
\leanok
\uses{lem:kcapture}
For every positive read-two display and every coordinate \(i\), a fair
restriction satisfies
\[
 \E\!\left[\mathbf 1_{\{i\in U(g)\}}I_i(g)\right]
 \ge \frac{13}{56}I_i(f).
\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
If \(i\) occurs in at most one term, retaining it suffices, giving the
stronger coefficient \(1/2\). Otherwise let \(u\) and \(v\) be the masses
of true \(i\)-pivotal inputs at which one and two incident terms fire,
respectively, so \(I_i(f)=2(u+v)\). Write the incident supports as
\(V_j,V_\ell\), ordered by increasing width, and put
\(r=|V_j\setminus V_\ell|\), \(q=2^r\).
Conditional on retaining \(i\), freezing one zero witness captures at
least \(u/2\) from single firing; freezing \(V_j\setminus V_\ell\)
makes the smaller term subsume the other and captures at least \(v/q\).
Lowering either difference block from all ones to each non-all-one pattern
injects double-firing inputs into the corresponding single-firing inputs,
so \(u\ge2(q-1)v\). Consequently
\[
 \frac u2+\frac vq-\frac{13}{28}(u+v)
 \ge\frac{(2q-7)(q-4)}{28q}v\ge0
 \qquad(q\in\{1,2,4,8,\dots\}).
\]
Pairing the two endpoints of every retained pivotal edge and multiplying by
the retention probability \(1/2\) turns this conditional captured mass into
at least \(13I_i(f)/56\) expected captured influence.
\end{proof}

    \begin{proposition}[unate read-$k$ FEI]\label{prop:unate}
\lean{FEI.ReadKUnate.unate_readk_exact_fei}
\leanok
\uses{lem:readone,lem:absorb,lem:kcapture,lem:onecapture}
Every unate read-$k$ DNF, \(k\ge2\), satisfies
\[
 H(f)\le\bigl(8+KT_{2k-1}\bigr)I(f).
\]
At read two the coefficient improves to \(8+56K/13\).
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
Gauge the display positive and capture read-one coordinates.  Apply
\cref{lem:absorb} with \(A=8\) and
\(\delta=(1-p)^{2k-2}\), optimizing at \(p=1/(2k-1)\).  At read two use
\cref{lem:onecapture} with \(p=1/2\) and \(\delta=13/28\).
\end{proof}

    Lemma · lem:polarity · blueprint/src/closed_case_read_k_short_capture_body.tex:361
    LaTeX source
    \begin{lemma}[polarity capture]\label{lem:polarity}
\lean{FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Capture.polarity_capture}
\leanok
\uses{lem:kcapture}
For every signed read-$k$ display, \(k\ge1\), under a \(p\)-restriction,
\(0<p<1\), if
\(U(g)\subseteq\operatorname{Free}(g)\) consists of the free coordinates
occurring with at most one surviving polarity, then
\[
 \E I_{U(g)}(g)\ge p(1-p)^{k-1}I(f).
\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
\leanok
At a pivotal \(i\)-edge, choose one off-\(i\) falsifying witness for each
term of the opposing polarity.  There are at most \(k-1\) witnesses.  Retain
\(i\) and freeze them; the edge survives and \(i\) becomes unate.
\end{proof}

  have hc : (0:ℝ) < (Real.log 2)⁻¹ := by positivity

/-! ## 3. #569 Lemma 9.1: one private variable gives the termwise pivotal bound

The note's two-coordinate comparison, formalised as an explicit injection.  For
each `x` at which exactly `j` fires, its `{i,z}`-square contains **two**
`i`-pivotal points; and distinct such `x` have disjoint squares, because firing
pins both `x_i` and `x_z` to the term's pattern.  That gives
`|Piv_i| ≥ 2|U_j|`.

The hypothesis is one private variable and nothing else: no read bound, no
width bound, no disjointness, no bound on how many other terms conflict with
`j` on a single literal. -/

variable {n : ℕ} {τ : Type*} [DecidableEq τ]

    ∀ {n : ℕ} {τ : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq τ] (F : FEI.SEQ4.SignedDNF.Formula (Fin n) τ) {r : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : Fin n), ∃ l, i ∈ FEI.ReadTwo.supp F l) →
    (∀ (j l : FEI.ReadTwo.Term F),
        j ≠ l →
          r < (FEI.ReadTwo.supp F j).card →
            r < (FEI.ReadTwo.supp F l).card → Disjoint (FEI.ReadTwo.supp F j) (FEI.ReadTwo.supp F l)) →
      ∀ (S : Finset (Fin n)) ⦃x : Fin n⦄,
        x ∈ S → x ∈ FEI.WidthBand.coverGround (FEI.ReadTwo.supp F) (FEI.Disjoint.cover F r S)
    theorem subset_coverGround (F : Formula (Fin n) τ) {r : ℕ}
    (hused : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ l : Term F, i ∈ supp F l)
    (hdisj : ∀ j l : Term F, j ≠ l → r < (supp F j).card → r < (supp F l).card →
      Disjoint (supp F j) (supp F l))
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    S ⊆ FEI.WidthBand.coverGround (supp F) (cover F r S) := by

  intro i hi
  rw [FEI.WidthBand.coverGround, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  by_cases hA : i ∈ shortVars F r
  · obtain ⟨l, hl, hil⟩ := mem_shortOf_supp F r hA
    refine ⟨l, ?_, hil⟩
    rw [cover, Finset.mem_union]
    exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      ⟨i, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi, hA⟩, hl⟩)
  · -- `i` is in no short term, so every term through it is wide
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hused i
    have hwide : ∀ m : Term F, i ∈ supp F m → r < (supp F m).card := by
      intro m hm

    theorem wide_charge_le (F : Formula (Fin n) τ) {r : ℕ}
    (hdisj : ∀ j l : Term F, j ≠ l → r < (supp F j).card → r < (supp F l).card →
      Disjoint (supp F j) (supp F l)) :

        ((supp F j).card : ℝ)
          * FEI.WidthBand.occupation
              (FEI.WidthBand.dnfSign (supp F) (pat F)) (privateBlock F j)
      ≤ 2 * FEI.totalInfluence (FEI.WidthBand.dnfSign (supp F) (pat F)) := by

  set W : Finset (Term F) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Term F => r < (supp F j).card) with hW_def

  -- termwise

      ((supp F j).card : ℝ) * FEI.WidthBand.occupation f (privateBlock F j)
        ≤ 2 * ∑ i ∈ supp F j, FEI.influenceOf f i := by

    rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty (privateBlock F j) with he | ⟨z, hz⟩
    · rw [he, hf_def, occupation_empty, mul_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hnn i))
    · have hocc : FEI.WidthBand.occupation f (privateBlock F j)
          ≤ 4 * uniqueProb F j := occupation_privateBlock_le F j
      have hinf : 2 * ((supp F j).card : ℝ) * uniqueProb F j
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ supp F j, FEI.influenceOf f i := term_influence_ge F hz
      have hw : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((supp F j).card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      nlinarith [hocc, hinf, hw]
  -- and the supports are disjoint, so the termwise sums fit inside `I`

    intro j hj l hl hjl
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, hW_def, Finset.mem_filter] at hj hl
    exact hdisj j l hjl hj.2 hl.2
  have hsum : ∑ j ∈ W, ∑ i ∈ supp F j, FEI.influenceOf f i
      ≤ FEI.totalInfluence f := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_biUnion hpd]
    unfold FEI.totalInfluence
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun i _ _ => hnn i)
  calc ∑ j ∈ W, ((supp F j).card : ℝ) * FEI.WidthBand.occupation f (privateBlock F j)
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ W, 2 * ∑ i ∈ supp F j, FEI.influenceOf f i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = 2 * ∑ j ∈ W, ∑ i ∈ supp F j, FEI.influenceOf f i := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 2 * FEI.totalInfluence f := by linarith

    rw [glue_of_mem (Finset.mem_inter.mp hi).2]
  have h2 : FEI.chi (S \ P) (glue P z c) = FEI.chi (S \ P) c := by
    unfold FEI.chi

    _ = FEI.chi (S ∩ P) z * FEI.chi (S \ P) c := by rw [h1, h2]

    ∀ {a b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → FEI.PrivateCore.entTwoNat a b ≤ (√a - √b) ^ 2 / 2
    theorem entTwoNat_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    entTwoNat a b ≤ (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) ^ 2 / 2 := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ a + b) with hab | hab
  · have ha0 : a = 0 := by linarith
    have hb0 : b = 0 := by linarith
    simp [entTwoNat, ha0, hb0]
  · set m : ℝ := (a + b) / 2 with hm
    have hmpos : 0 < m := by rw [hm]; linarith
    set s : ℝ := (a - b) / (a + b) with hs
    have hsum : a + b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hab
    have hA : a = m * (1 + s) := by rw [hm, hs]; field_simp; ring
    have hB : b = m * (1 - s) := by rw [hm, hs]; field_simp; ring
    have habs : |s| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hs, abs_div, abs_of_pos hab, div_le_one hab]
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have h1p : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + s := by
      have := abs_le.mp habs; linarith [this.1]
    have h1m : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - s := by
      have := abs_le.mp habs; linarith [this.2]
    -- left side
    have hleft : entTwoNat a b
        = m * (((1 + s) * Real.log (1 + s) + (1 - s) * Real.log (1 - s)) / 2) := by
      rw [hA, hB, entTwoNat_smul hmpos h1p h1m, entTwoNat_one_add_sub]
    -- right side
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b
        = Real.sqrt m * (Real.sqrt (1 + s) - Real.sqrt (1 - s)) := by
      rw [hA, hB, Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt hmpos), Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt hmpos)]
      ring
    have hprod : Real.sqrt (1 + s) * Real.sqrt (1 - s) = Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_mul h1p]; congr 1; ring
    have hright : (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) ^ 2 / 2
        = m * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2)) := by
      rw [hsqrt, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hmpos)]
      have e1 : Real.sqrt (1 + s) ^ 2 = 1 + s := Real.sq_sqrt h1p
      have e2 : Real.sqrt (1 - s) ^ 2 = 1 - s := Real.sq_sqrt h1m
      have : (Real.sqrt (1 + s) - Real.sqrt (1 - s)) ^ 2
          = (1 + s) + (1 - s) - 2 * Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2) := by
        rw [sub_sq, e1, e2]
        rw [show (2:ℝ) * Real.sqrt (1 + s) * Real.sqrt (1 - s)
              = 2 * (Real.sqrt (1 + s) * Real.sqrt (1 - s)) by ring, hprod]
        ring

    (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    FEI.expect (fun z => FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T)
      = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), if S \ P = T then FEI.spectralProb f S else 0 := by

  set a : Finset (Fin n) → (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ :=
    fun S z => if S \ P = T then FEI.fourierCoeff f S * FEI.chi (S ∩ P) z else 0 with ha

    intro z
    unfold FEI.spectralProb
    rw [fourierCoeff_restr P f z T]
    rw [sq]
    exact Finset.sum_mul_sum _ _ _ _
  have hexp : ∀ S S' : Finset (Fin n),
      FEI.expect (fun z => a S z * a S' z)
        = if S \ P = T then (if S' \ P = T then
            (if S ∩ P = S' ∩ P then FEI.fourierCoeff f S * FEI.fourierCoeff f S' else 0)
            else 0) else 0 := by

    by_cases h1 : S \ P = T
    · by_cases h2 : S' \ P = T
      · simp only [ha, h1, h2, if_true]
        have : (fun z => FEI.fourierCoeff f S * FEI.chi (S ∩ P) z

          funext z; ring

        by_cases h3 : S ∩ P = S' ∩ P <;> simp [h3]
      · simp [ha, h1, h2, expect_zero]
    · simp [ha, h1, expect_zero]
  rw [show (fun z => FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T)
        = fun z => ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), ∑ S' : Finset (Fin n), a S z * a S' z from

    private lemma hasDerivAt_GFun {s : ℝ} (h : |s| < 1) :
    HasDerivAt GFun (psiFun s) s := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) + s ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hm : (1 : ℝ) - s ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hne : Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sqrt_pos_of_abs_lt_one h)
  have hAin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 + t) 1 s := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_add 1)
  have hBin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t) (-1) s := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_sub 1)
  have hAlog : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.log (1 + t)) (1 / (1 + s)) s :=
    hAin.log (by simpa using hp)
  have hBlog : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.log (1 - t)) (-1 / (1 - s)) s :=
    hBin.log (by simpa using hm)
  have hA : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t) * Real.log (1 + t))
      (1 * Real.log (1 + s) + (1 + s) * (1 / (1 + s))) s := hAin.mul hAlog
  have hB : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 - t) * Real.log (1 - t))
      (-1 * Real.log (1 - s) + (1 - s) * (-1 / (1 - s))) s := hBin.mul hBlog
  have hsum : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => ((1 + t) * Real.log (1 + t) + (1 - t) * Real.log (1 - t)) / 2)
      (((1 * Real.log (1 + s) + (1 + s) * (1 / (1 + s)))
        + (-1 * Real.log (1 - s) + (1 - s) * (-1 / (1 - s)))) / 2) s :=
    (hA.add hB).div_const 2
  have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2))
      (-(-s / Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2))) s :=
    (hasDerivAt_sqrtOneSub h).const_sub 1
  have hd : HasDerivAt GFun
      (-(-s / Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2))
        - ((1 * Real.log (1 + s) + (1 + s) * (1 / (1 + s)))
           + (-1 * Real.log (1 - s) + (1 - s) * (-1 / (1 - s)))) / 2) s :=
    hsq.sub hsum
  have hval : -(-s / Real.sqrt (1 - s ^ 2))
      - ((1 * Real.log (1 + s) + (1 + s) * (1 / (1 + s)))
         + (-1 * Real.log (1 - s) + (1 - s) * (-1 / (1 - s)))) / 2

    ring

    private lemma hasDerivAt_logHalf {s : ℝ} (h : |s| < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (Real.log (1 + t) - Real.log (1 - t)) / 2)
      (1 / (1 - s ^ 2)) s := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) + s ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hm : (1 : ℝ) - s ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hA : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.log (1 + t)) (1 / (1 + s)) s :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_add 1).log (by simpa using hp)
  have hBin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t) (-1) s := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_sub 1)
  have hB : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.log (1 - t)) (-1 / (1 - s)) s :=
    hBin.log (by simpa using hm)
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (Real.log (1 + t) - Real.log (1 - t)) / 2)
      ((1 / (1 + s) - -1 / (1 - s)) / 2) s := (hA.sub hB).div_const 2
  have hval : (1 / (1 + s) - -1 / (1 - s)) / 2 = 1 / (1 - s ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by nlinarith)]
    field_simp
    ring
  rwa [hval] at hd

  FEI.PrivateCore.mixtureMI f P =
    FEI.PrivateCore.coreEntropy f P - FEI.expect fun z => FEI.PrivateCore.specEnt (FEI.PrivateCore.restr P f z)
    theorem mixture_mutualInfo_eq (P : Finset (Fin n)) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) :
    mixtureMI f P
      = coreEntropy f P - FEI.expect (fun z => specEnt (restr P f z)) := by
  classical
  have hnn : ∀ (z : Fin n → Bool) (T : Finset (Fin n)),
      0 ≤ FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T := by
    intro z T; unfold FEI.spectralProb; positivity
  -- pointwise splitting of the divergence term
  have hpt : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin n)) (z : Fin n → Bool),
      FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T
        * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T / coreLaw f P T)
      = FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T
          * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T)
        - Real.logb 2 (coreLaw f P T) * FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T := by
    intro T z
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hnn z T) with h | h
    · rw [← h]; simp
    · have hle : FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T
          ≤ ∑ z' : Fin n → Bool, FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z') T :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun z' _ => hnn z' T) (Finset.mem_univ z)
      have hq : 0 < coreLaw f P T := by
        rw [coreLaw_eq_mixture]
        unfold FEI.expect
        exact div_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le h hle) (by positivity)
      rw [Real.logb_div (ne_of_gt h) (ne_of_gt hq)]
      ring
  have step : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n),
      FEI.expect (fun z => FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T
          * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T / coreLaw f P T))
        = FEI.expect (fun z => FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T
            * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T))
          - Real.logb 2 (coreLaw f P T) * coreLaw f P T := by
    intro T
    rw [show (fun z => FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T
            * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T / coreLaw f P T))
          = fun z => FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T
              * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T)
            - Real.logb 2 (coreLaw f P T) * FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T from
        funext (hpt T)]
    rw [FEI.expect_sub, expect_const_mul, ← coreLaw_eq_mixture]
  have hswap : FEI.expect (fun z => specEnt (restr P f z))
      = ∑ T : Finset (Fin n), FEI.expect (fun z =>
          -(FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T)
            * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T)) := by

    exact expect_sum _

            * Real.logb 2 (FEI.spectralProb (restr P f z) T)) := by
    intro T
    rw [← FEI.expect_neg]
    congr 1
    funext z
    ring
  have key : mixtureMI f P + FEI.expect (fun z => specEnt (restr P f z))
      = coreEntropy f P := by
    rw [hswap]
    unfold mixtureMI coreEntropy FEI.specEntropy
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun T _ => ?_)
    rw [step T, hneg T]
    ring
  linarith [key]

/-! ## 8. The lowering injection

`u_ℓ ≥ (2^{|V_j ∖ V_ℓ|} − 1) v`.  The manuscript builds an explicit injection
from double-firing inputs times the non-all-one patterns of the block.  **This
proof does not count patterns.**  Conditioning on the coordinates outside the
block --- `FEI.PrivateCore.expect_glue` --- the double-firing event forces the
block to be all ones, so it has conditional probability at most `2^{-|B|}`,
while *every* other block value gives a single-firing input with the same
outer coordinates, so the single-firing event has conditional probability at
least `1 - 2^{-|B|}`.  The ratio is the same `2^{|B|} - 1`, with no
combinatorial bookkeeping. -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in

    theorem captureProb_ge (D : Display n s) (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → Bool)
    (B : Finset (Fin n)) (hiB : i ∉ B)
    (hcap : ∀ mask : Fin n → Bool, mask i = true → (∀ k ∈ B, mask k = false) →

    · rw [if_neg h]
      by_cases h' : readOneAt D mask x i
      · rw [if_pos h']; norm_num
      · rw [if_neg h']

/-! ## 3. Halving: a pivotal edge has two endpoints

`readOneAt` does not read `x i` when `i` is retained, and the pivotal indicator
is flip-invariant, so restricting to the endpoint with `x i = true` halves both
the captured count and `I_i(f)` exactly.  The manuscript's "count both
orientations of each original edge". -/

        if readOneAt D mask z i then
          FEI.influenceOf (restr (frozen mask) D.signOf z) i else 0)

            FEI.flipAt_self, glue_of_not_mem (not_mem_frozen mask hi)]

          · rw [glue_of_mem hkP, glue_of_mem hkP]
          · rw [glue_of_not_mem hkP, glue_of_not_mem hkP, FEI.flipAt_of_ne hk]

          = FEI.expect (fun c => pivInd D i (glue (frozen mask) z c)) := by

          intro c
          exact D.isBoolean_signOf _

        refine congrArg FEI.expect (funext (fun c => ?_))
        rw [FEI.WidthBand.deriv_sq_eq_indicator hb i c]

        if FEI.ShortReadKCapture.readOneAt D mask z i then
          FEI.influenceOf (FEI.PrivateCore.restr (FEI.ShortReadKCapture.frozen mask) (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.signOf D) z)
            i
        else 0) =
    2 *
      FEI.expect fun x =>
        FEI.ReadKCapture.trueHalf i (FEI.ReadKCapture.pivInd D i) x * FEI.ReadKCapture.captureProb D i x
    theorem capture_eq_trueHalf_captureProb (D : Display n s) (i : Fin n) :
    FEI.expect (fun mask : Fin n → Bool =>
      FEI.expect (fun z : Fin n → Bool =>
        if readOneAt D mask z i then
          FEI.influenceOf (restr (frozen mask) D.signOf z) i else 0))
      = 2 * FEI.expect (fun x => trueHalf i (pivInd D i) x * captureProb D i x) := by
  classical
  rw [capture_eq_glued D i]
  have hhalf : ∀ mask : Fin n → Bool,
      FEI.expect (capInd D mask i) = 2 * FEI.expect (trueHalf i (capInd D mask i)) :=
    fun mask => expect_eq_two_mul_trueHalf i (capInd D mask i) (capInd_flipAt D mask i)
  rw [show (fun mask : Fin n → Bool => FEI.expect (capInd D mask i))
      = fun mask => 2 * FEI.expect (trueHalf i (capInd D mask i)) from funext hhalf,
    FEI.WidthBand.expect_mul_const, expect_comm]
  congr 1
  refine congrArg FEI.expect (funext (fun x => ?_))
  have hpt : ∀ mask : Fin n → Bool, trueHalf i (capInd D mask i) x
      = trueHalf i (pivInd D i) x * (if readOneAt D mask x i then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro mask
    unfold trueHalf capInd
    by_cases hx : x i = true
    · rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hx]
      by_cases h : readOneAt D mask x i
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, mul_one]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero]
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg hx, zero_mul]
  rw [show (fun mask : Fin n → Bool => trueHalf i (capInd D mask i) x)
      = fun mask => trueHalf i (pivInd D i) x
          * (if readOneAt D mask x i then (1:ℝ) else 0) from funext hpt,
    FEI.WidthBand.expect_mul_const]
  rfl

    ∀ {n : ℕ} (σ : Fin n → Bool) (V : Finset (Fin n)),
  (FEI.expect fun x => if ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k then 1 else 0) = (2 ^ V.card)⁻¹
    lemma expect_agree_on (σ : Fin n → Bool) (V : Finset (Fin n)) :
    FEI.expect (fun x : Fin n → Bool => if ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0)
      = ((2:ℝ) ^ V.card)⁻¹ := by
  classical
  induction V using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, false_implies, implies_true, if_pos,
        Finset.card_empty, pow_zero, inv_one]
      exact FEI.WidthBand.expect_const 1
  | @insert a V ha ih =>
      have hsplit : (fun x : Fin n → Bool =>
          if ∀ k ∈ insert a V, x k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0)
          = fun x => (if x a = σ a then (1:ℝ) else 0)
            * (if ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
        funext x
        by_cases h1 : x a = σ a
        · by_cases h2 : ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k
          · rw [if_pos (fun k hk => (Finset.mem_insert.mp hk).elim
              (fun hc => hc ▸ h1) (fun hc => h2 k hc)), if_pos h1, if_pos h2, mul_one]
          · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h2 (fun k hk => hc k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk))),
              if_pos h1, if_neg h2, mul_zero]
        · rw [if_neg (fun hc => h1 (hc a (Finset.mem_insert_self a V))),
            if_neg h1, zero_mul]
      have hGinv : ∀ x : Fin n → Bool,
          (if ∀ k ∈ V, FEI.flipAt x a k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0)
            = (if ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
        intro x
        have hiff : (∀ k ∈ V, FEI.flipAt x a k = σ k) ↔ (∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k) := by
          constructor <;> intro hh k hk
          · rw [← FEI.flipAt_of_ne (x := x) (i := a) (by rintro rfl; exact ha hk)]
            exact hh k hk
          · rw [FEI.flipAt_of_ne (by rintro rfl; exact ha hk)]
            exact hh k hk
        by_cases hh : ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k
        · rw [if_pos (hiff.mpr hh), if_pos hh]
        · rw [if_neg (fun hc => hh (hiff.mp hc)), if_neg hh]
      have hhalf := expect_eq_two_mul_half a (σ a)
        (fun x : Fin n → Bool => if ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0) hGinv
      rw [hsplit]
      have hmul : (fun x : Fin n → Bool => (if x a = σ a then (1:ℝ) else 0)
            * (if ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0))
          = fun x => if x a = σ a
              then (if ∀ k ∈ V, x k = σ k then (1:ℝ) else 0) else 0 := by
        funext x
        by_cases h1 : x a = σ a
        · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h1, one_mul]
        · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h1, zero_mul]
      rw [hmul, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha, pow_succ]
      rw [ih] at hhalf
      have h2 : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ V.card := by positivity
      field_simp at hhalf ⊢
      linarith

/-! ## 7. The capture events

Each is "retain `i`, and freeze a block `B` avoiding `i`", of probability
`2^{-(|B|+1)}` under the fair mask.  What the block is depends on the firing
set at `x`, and that is the whole case analysis of `lem:onecapture`. -/

    have hki : k ≠ i := fun hc => hiV (hc ▸ hk)
    rw [FEI.flipAt_of_ne hki]
    exact hm k hk
  rw [h.2.2] at this
  exact absurd this (Finset.notMem_empty m)

/-! ## 6. Mask probabilities

The capture events are "retain `i`, and freeze a block `B` disjoint from `i`".
Under the fair mask that has probability `2^{-(|B|+1)}`.

`FEI.Extremal.expect_agree` proves the same counting fact, but it lives in
`lean/fei_extremal_cavity.lean`, which imports the read-two cover chain of
PR #603.  Importing it here would put the whole of that case on the read-`k`
case's dependency path for twenty lines of uniform-measure counting, so the
counting is redone; nothing analytic is duplicated. -/

    • hpos : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Positive D (explicit)
    • hjl : j ≠ l (explicit)
    • hinc : FEI.UnateRT2.Display.incident D i = {j, l} (explicit)
    Full elaborated type
    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s),
  FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Positive D →
    ∀ (i : Fin n) {j l : Fin s},
      j ≠ l →
        FEI.UnateRT2.Display.incident D i = {j, l} →
          ((2 ^ (D.V j \ D.V l).card - 1) *
              FEI.expect fun x =>
                if FEI.ReadKCapture.TP D i x ∧ FEI.UnateRT2.Display.fireSet D x = {j, l} then 1 else 0) ≤
            FEI.expect fun x => if FEI.ReadKCapture.TP D i x ∧ FEI.UnateRT2.Display.fireSet D x = {l} then 1 else 0
    theorem lowering (D : Display n s) (hpos : Positive D) (i : Fin n)
    {j l : Fin s} (hjl : j ≠ l) (hinc : D.incident i = {j, l}) :
    ((2:ℝ) ^ ((D.V j \ D.V l).card) - 1)
        * FEI.expect (fun x => if TP D i x ∧ D.fireSet x = {j, l} then (1:ℝ) else 0)
      ≤ FEI.expect (fun x => if TP D i x ∧ D.fireSet x = {l} then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
  classical
  set B : Finset (Fin n) := D.V j \ D.V l with hB
  have hBj : B ⊆ D.V j := fun k hk => (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk).1
  have hBl : ∀ k ∈ D.V l, k ∉ B := fun k hk hc => (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hc).2 hk
  have hiVl : i ∈ D.V l := by
    have : l ∈ D.incident i := by rw [hinc]; simp
    exact (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.mem_incident D).mp this
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ, ∀ y,
      Φ y = if TP D i y ∧ D.fireSet y = {j, l} then (1:ℝ) else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ, ∀ y,
      Ψ y = if TP D i y ∧ D.fireSet y = {l} then (1:ℝ) else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  -- the conditional bound, at a fixed outer configuration
  have hcond : ∀ c : Fin n → Bool,
      ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card - 1) * FEI.expect (fun z => Φ (glue B z c))
        ≤ FEI.expect (fun z => Ψ (glue B z c)) := by
    intro c
    have hΨnn : 0 ≤ FEI.expect (fun z => Ψ (glue B z c)) := by
      refine FEI.WidthBand.expect_nonneg (fun z => ?_)
      rw [hΨ]
      by_cases h : TP D i (glue B z c) ∧ D.fireSet (glue B z c) = {l}
      · rw [if_pos h]; norm_num
      · rw [if_neg h]
    by_cases hex : ∃ z₀ : Fin n → Bool,
        TP D i (glue B z₀ c) ∧ D.fireSet (glue B z₀ c) = {j, l}
    · obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hex
      have hz₀B : ∀ k ∈ B, glue B z₀ c k = true := by
        intro k hk
        have hjf : j ∈ D.fireSet (glue B z₀ c) := by rw [hz₀.2]; simp
        exact (mem_fireSet_iff D hpos _ j).mp hjf k (hBj hk)
      -- the double-firing event forces the block to be all ones
      have hA : FEI.expect (fun z => Φ (glue B z c)) ≤ ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← expect_agree_on (fun _ => true) B]
        refine FEI.WidthBand.expect_mono (fun z => ?_)
        rw [hΦ]
        by_cases h : TP D i (glue B z c) ∧ D.fireSet (glue B z c) = {j, l}
        · rw [if_pos h, if_pos]
          intro k hk
          have hjf : j ∈ D.fireSet (glue B z c) := by rw [h.2]; simp
          have := (mem_fireSet_iff D hpos _ j).mp hjf k (hBj hk)
          rwa [glue_of_mem hk] at this
        · rw [if_neg h]
          by_cases h2 : ∀ k ∈ B, z k = true
          · rw [if_pos h2]; norm_num
          · rw [if_neg h2]
      -- every other block value gives a single-firing input
      have hC : (1:ℝ) - ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card)⁻¹ ≤ FEI.expect (fun z => Ψ (glue B z c)) := by
        have hone : FEI.expect (fun z : Fin n → Bool =>
            1 - (if ∀ k ∈ B, z k = true then (1:ℝ) else 0))
            = 1 - ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card)⁻¹ := by
          rw [show (fun z : Fin n → Bool =>
              1 - (if ∀ k ∈ B, z k = true then (1:ℝ) else 0))
              = fun z => 1 + (-1) * (if ∀ k ∈ B, z k = true then (1:ℝ) else 0) from
            funext (fun z => by ring), FEI.WidthBand.expect_add,
            FEI.WidthBand.expect_const, FEI.WidthBand.expect_mul_const,
            expect_agree_on]
          ring
        rw [← hone]
        refine FEI.WidthBand.expect_mono (fun z => ?_)
        by_cases h2 : ∀ k ∈ B, z k = true
        · rw [if_pos h2, sub_self, hΨ]
          by_cases h : TP D i (glue B z c) ∧ D.fireSet (glue B z c) = {l}
          · rw [if_pos h]; norm_num
          · rw [if_neg h]
        · rw [if_neg h2, sub_zero, hΨ, if_pos ?_]
          -- the single-firing event holds at every non-all-one block value
          push_neg at h2
          obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀B, hk₀⟩ := h2
          have hyle : ∀ k, glue B z c k = true → glue B z₀ c k = true := by
            intro k hk
            by_cases hkB : k ∈ B
            · exact hz₀B k hkB
            · rw [glue_of_not_mem hkB] at hk ⊢; exact hk
          have hagree : ∀ k ∈ D.V l, glue B z c k = glue B z₀ c k := by
            intro k hk
            rw [glue_of_not_mem (hBl k hk), glue_of_not_mem (hBl k hk)]
          have hlfire : l ∈ D.fireSet (glue B z c) := by
            have hl0 : l ∈ D.fireSet (glue B z₀ c) := by rw [hz₀.2]; simp
            rw [mem_fireSet_iff D hpos] at hl0 ⊢
            intro k hk
            rw [hagree k hk]; exact hl0 k hk
          have hjnot : j ∉ D.fireSet (glue B z c) := by
            intro hc'
            have := (mem_fireSet_iff D hpos _ j).mp hc' k₀ (hBj hk₀B)
            rw [glue_of_mem hk₀B] at this
            exact hk₀ this
          have hfs : D.fireSet (glue B z c) = {l} := by
            refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨hlfire, fun m hm => ?_⟩
            have := fireSet_mono D hpos hyle hm
            rw [hz₀.2, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at this
            rcases this with rfl | h
            · exact absurd hm hjnot
            · exact h
          have hii : glue B z c i = true := by
            rw [glue_of_not_mem (hBl i hiVl)]
            have := hz₀.1.1
            rwa [glue_of_not_mem (hBl i hiVl)] at this
          refine ⟨⟨hii, ?_, ?_⟩, hfs⟩
          · rw [hfs]; simp
          · rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
            intro m hm
            have hmono := fireSet_mono D hpos
              (flipAt_le i (by
                rw [glue_of_not_mem (hBl i hiVl), glue_of_not_mem (hBl i hiVl)])
                hyle) hm
            rw [hz₀.1.2.2] at hmono
            exact absurd hmono (Finset.notMem_empty m)
      have hpow : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ B.card := by positivity
      have hid : ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card - 1) * ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card)⁻¹
          = 1 - ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card)⁻¹ := by field_simp
      have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ B.card - 1 := by
        have : (1:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ B.card := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
        linarith
      calc ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card - 1) * FEI.expect (fun z => Φ (glue B z c))
          ≤ ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card - 1) * ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA hnn
        _ = 1 - ((2:ℝ) ^ B.card)⁻¹ := hid
        _ ≤ _ := hC
    · push_neg at hex
      have : FEI.expect (fun z => Φ (glue B z c)) = 0 := by
        rw [show (fun z : Fin n → Bool => Φ (glue B z c)) = fun _ => (0:ℝ) from
          funext (fun z => by rw [hΦ, if_neg (fun hc => hex z hc.1 hc.2)])]
        exact FEI.WidthBand.expect_const 0
      rw [this, mul_zero]
      exact hΨnn
  -- average over the outer configuration
  have hgΦ : FEI.expect Φ = FEI.expect (fun c => FEI.expect (fun z => Φ (glue B z c))) := by
    rw [← expect_comm (fun z c => Φ (glue B z c))]
    exact (expect_glue B Φ).symm
  have hgΨ : FEI.expect Ψ = FEI.expect (fun c => FEI.expect (fun z => Ψ (glue B z c))) := by
    rw [← expect_comm (fun z c => Ψ (glue B z c))]
    exact (expect_glue B Ψ).symm
  rw [show (fun x : Fin n → Bool =>
      if TP D i x ∧ D.fireSet x = {j, l} then (1:ℝ) else 0) = Φ from
    (funext hΦ).symm,
    show (fun x : Fin n → Bool =>
      if TP D i x ∧ D.fireSet x = {l} then (1:ℝ) else 0) = Ψ from (funext hΨ).symm,
    hgΦ, hgΨ, ← FEI.WidthBand.expect_mul_const]
  exact FEI.WidthBand.expect_mono hcond

/-! ## 9. The two-term calculation, and `lem:onecapture`

At a true pivotal endpoint the firing set is `{j}`, `{ℓ}` or `{j,ℓ}`, and the
three capture bounds are `1/4`, `1/4` and `2^{-(r+1)}`.  The lowering estimate
links the masses, and the case check `(2q-7)(q-4) ≥ 0` over `q = 2^r ∈
{1,2,4}` or `q ≥ 8` closes it.  Minimum "width" is not what is spent here:
what is spent is that `q` is a **power of two**, so it never lands on the
interval `(3.5, 4)` where the polynomial is negative. -/

  j ≠ l →
    FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Survives D P z j →
      FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Survives D P z l →
        D.V j \ P ⊆ D.V l \ P →
          j ∉ FEI.ShortReadKCapture.minimalLabels D P z ∨ l ∉ FEI.ShortReadKCapture.minimalLabels D P z
    theorem not_both_minimal (D : Display n s) (P : Finset (Fin n)) (z : Fin n → Bool)
    {j l : Fin s} (hjl : j ≠ l) (hj : Survives D P z j) (hl : Survives D P z l)
    (hsub : D.V j \ P ⊆ D.V l \ P) :
    j ∉ minimalLabels D P z ∨ l ∉ minimalLabels D P z := by
  classical
  by_cases hlmin : l ∈ minimalLabels D P z
  · left
    intro hjmin
    -- `l` minimal forbids `j` from strictly subsuming it, so the two agree
    -- and `l` precedes `j`; then `l` removes `j`.
    unfold minimalLabels at hlmin
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hlmin
    have hno := hlmin.2.2
    have heq : D.V j \ P = D.V l \ P ∧ ¬ j < l := by
      by_contra hc
      exact hno ⟨j, hj, hsub, by
        rcases not_and_or.mp hc with h | h
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (not_not.mp h)⟩
    have hlj : l < j := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy l j with h | h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h.symm hjl
      · exact absurd h heq.2
    unfold minimalLabels at hjmin
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hjmin
    exact hjmin.2.2 ⟨l, hl, by rw [heq.1], Or.inr hlj⟩
  · exact Or.inr hlmin

    theorem transfer_factor_attained {a : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) :

/-! ## The coefficient of `prop:unate`

`lem:absorb` delivers `H(f) ≤ (A + K/(p·δ)) I(f)`. Proposition 6 takes `A = 8`
from `lem:readone`, `δ = (1-p)^(2k-2)` from `lem:kcapture`, and then *chooses*
`p = 1/(2k-1)`. The lemma below is what that choice buys: at `p = 1/a` the
product `p·δ` is exactly `1/T_a`, so `K/(p·δ)` is exactly `K·T_a` and the
coefficient is `unateCoefficient k`.

This is the one step of Proposition 6's proof that is not an application of
another lemma, and it is proved here. -/

    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s),
  FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Positive D →
    ∀ (i : Fin n) {j l : Fin s},
      j ≠ l →
        FEI.UnateRT2.Display.incident D i = {j, l} →
          (D.V j \ D.V l).card ≤ (D.V l \ D.V j).card →
            (13 / 56 * FEI.expect fun x => if FEI.ReadKCapture.TP D i x then 1 else 0) ≤
              FEI.expect fun x => (if FEI.ReadKCapture.TP D i x then 1 else 0) * FEI.ReadKCapture.captureProb D i x
    theorem two_term_bound (D : Display n s) (hpos : Positive D) (i : Fin n)
    {j l : Fin s} (hjl : j ≠ l) (hinc : D.incident i = {j, l})
    (hr : (D.V j \ D.V l).card ≤ (D.V l \ D.V j).card) :
    (13/56 : ℝ) * FEI.expect (fun x => if TP D i x then (1:ℝ) else 0)
      ≤ FEI.expect (fun x =>
          (if TP D i x then (1:ℝ) else 0) * captureProb D i x) := by
  classical
  set r : ℕ := (D.V j \ D.V l).card with hrdef
  set q : ℝ := (2:ℝ) ^ r with hqdef
  have hq1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ q := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨Aj, hAj⟩ : ∃ A : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ, ∀ x,
      A x = if TP D i x ∧ D.fireSet x = {j} then (1:ℝ) else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Al, hAl⟩ : ∃ A : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ, ∀ x,
      A x = if TP D i x ∧ D.fireSet x = {l} then (1:ℝ) else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Av, hAv⟩ : ∃ A : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ, ∀ x,
      A x = if TP D i x ∧ D.fireSet x = {j, l} then (1:ℝ) else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  -- (i) the three events partition the true pivotal endpoints
  have hpart : ∀ x, (if TP D i x then (1:ℝ) else 0) = Aj x + Al x + Av x := by
    intro x
    rw [hAj, hAl, hAv]
    by_cases hTP : TP D i x
    · rw [if_pos hTP]
      rcases fireSet_cases D hpos i hTP hinc with h | h | h
      · rw [if_pos ⟨hTP, h⟩,
          if_neg (fun hc => ne_sj_sl hjl (h.symm.trans hc.2)),
          if_neg (fun hc => ne_sj_p hjl (h.symm.trans hc.2))]
        ring
      · rw [if_neg (fun hc => ne_sj_sl hjl (hc.2.symm.trans h)),
          if_pos ⟨hTP, h⟩,
          if_neg (fun hc => ne_sl_p hjl (h.symm.trans hc.2))]
        ring
      · rw [if_neg (fun hc => ne_sj_p hjl (hc.2.symm.trans h)),
          if_neg (fun hc => ne_sl_p hjl (hc.2.symm.trans h)),
          if_pos ⟨hTP, h⟩]
        ring
    · rw [if_neg hTP, if_neg (fun hc => hTP hc.1), if_neg (fun hc => hTP hc.1),

    by_cases hTP : TP D i x

          if_neg (fun hc => ne_sj_p hjl (h.symm.trans hc.2))]

        norm_num
        linarith

        have hinc' : D.incident i = {l, j} := by rw [hinc, Finset.pair_comm]
        rw [hAj, hAl, hAv, if_neg (fun hc => ne_sj_sl hjl (hc.2.symm.trans h)),
          if_pos ⟨hTP, h⟩,
          if_neg (fun hc => ne_sl_p hjl (h.symm.trans hc.2))]
        have := captureProb_single D hpos i x hinc' hTP.1 hjnot
        norm_num
        linarith

        have hlf : l ∈ D.fireSet x := by rw [h]; simp
        rw [hAj, hAl, hAv, if_neg (fun hc => ne_sj_p hjl (hc.2.symm.trans h)),
          if_neg (fun hc => ne_sl_p hjl (hc.2.symm.trans h)), if_pos ⟨hTP, h⟩]

        linarith

    refine FEI.WidthBand.expect_nonneg (fun x => ?_)
    rw [hAv]

    · rw [if_neg h]

    rw [← FEI.WidthBand.expect_add, ← FEI.WidthBand.expect_add]

/-! ## 2. Step 4, the averaging, with no convexity API

`q^d ≥ q^D (1 + (d - D) log q)` is `exp t ≥ 1 + t` after writing both powers as
exponentials.  Averaging against a nonnegative weight whose `d`-mean is at most

/-! ## 3. Step 3: the freezing event captures

Freeze the private part of the first label, and in every incident term that does
not fire one coordinate where it is false.  Retaining `i` on top of that makes
`i` read-one in the normalised inherited display: the non-firing incident terms
are dead, and among the firing ones the first label subsumes all of them, so
subsumption leaves exactly one. -/

    refine ⟨hxi, Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.1 ⟨j0, hj0⟩, ?_⟩

      intro hc
      have h1 := hm i hc
      rw [FEI.flipAt_self, hxi] at h1
      simp at h1

      rw [FEI.ReadKMoment.mem_fireSet_iff D hpos]

      have h1 := hm k hk
      rwa [FEI.flipAt_of_ne (fun h : k = i => hiV (h ▸ hk))] at h1

    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s) (i : Fin n),
  (FEI.ReadKMoment.Tgt D i).card =
    ∑ y,
      if FEI.ReadKMoment.Piv D i y then (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.incident D i \ FEI.UnateRT2.Display.fireSet D y).card
      else 0
    theorem card_Tgt (D : Display n s) (i : Fin n) :

/-! ## 7. The injection

Each record `(x, j, k)` is sent to `(x with k lowered, j)`.  Recovery, which
is where the manuscript's "invertible given its target" lives: the first label
is inherited by the image (`isFirst_of_subset`), so `V_j ∖ V_ℓ` is determined
by the target and the killed label; and `k` is the unique coordinate of that
block at which the target is zero, because the source is all ones there. -/

    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s) {a b : Fin s},
  FEI.ReadKMoment.keyOf D a ≤ FEI.ReadKMoment.keyOf D b → (D.V a).card ≤ (D.V b).card
    lemma card_le_of_key_le (D : Display n s) {a b : Fin s}
    (h : keyOf D a ≤ keyOf D b) : (D.V a).card ≤ (D.V b).card := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have hb := b.isLt
  have : (D.V b).card * s + b.val < (D.V a).card * s := by
    calc (D.V b).card * s + b.val < (D.V b).card * s + s := by omega
      _ = ((D.V b).card + 1) * s := by ring
      _ ≤ (D.V a).card * s := Nat.mul_le_mul_right s (by omega)
  unfold keyOf at h
  omega

    theorem coordinatewise_first_moment (D : Display n s) (hpos : Positive D)

        (fun T => T.Nonempty ∧ i ∈ commonInter D T),

        else 0)
      ≤ ∑ y : Fin n → Bool,
        (if Piv D i y then (D.incident i \ D.fireSet y).card else 0) := by
    calc ∑ x : Fin n → Bool,
        (if Piv D i x then

          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => ?_)

            obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_isFirst D hx.1
            rw [outDeg_eq D i hx hl]
            exact mWidth_sub_le D hl

      _ = (Rec D i).card := sum_outDeg D i
      _ ≤ (Tgt D i).card := rec_card_le D hpos i
      _ = _ := card_Tgt D i
  -- transfer to the reals

        ((mWidth D T : ℝ) - ((commonInter D T).card : ℝ)) * vProb D T

    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
    show (if Piv D i y then ((D.incident i).card : ℝ) - ((D.fireSet y).card : ℝ)
        else 0)
      = ((if Piv D i y then (D.incident i \ D.fireSet y).card else 0 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    by_cases hy : Piv D i y
    · rw [if_pos hy, if_pos hy]
      have hs := fireSet_subset_incident D hy
      have hc := Finset.card_inter_add_card_sdiff (D.incident i) (D.fireSet y)

          = (D.incident i).card - (D.fireSet y).card := by omega
      rw [hcd, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hs)]
    · rw [if_neg hy, if_neg hy, Nat.cast_zero]

  refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hpow.le
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, ← Nat.cast_sum]
  exact_mod_cast hnat

/-! ## 6. The lowering records

**A departure from the manuscript's Step 2, and it removes most of its cost.**
The manuscript's map is *weighted*: replace the all-one block
`x_{V_j ∖ V_ℓ}` by each of its `2^a − 1` other patterns and give each image
weight `a/(2^a − 1) ≤ 1`, so that the total weight leaving `x` on behalf of
`j` is `a`.

The **single-coordinate** lowerings already do this with weight one: lower
exactly one `k ∈ V_j ∖ V_ℓ` from one to zero.  There are exactly `a` of them,
which is the same out-degree; each is a valid image for the same reasons
(`ℓ` survives because `k ∉ V_ℓ`, `j` dies because `k ∈ V_j`, and lowering
cannot switch a positive term on); and recovery is *easier*, because `k` is
the unique coordinate of `V_j ∖ V_ℓ` at which the image is zero — the source
is all ones there.

So the `2^a − 1` pattern count and the weights both disappear, and the map is
an ordinary injection on `(source, killed label, lowered coordinate)`. -/

    Full elaborated type
    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s),
  FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Positive D → ∀ (i : Fin n), (FEI.ReadKMoment.Rec D i).card ≤ (FEI.ReadKMoment.Tgt D i).card
    theorem rec_card_le (D : Display n s) (hpos : Positive D) (i : Fin n) :
    (Rec D i).card ≤ (Tgt D i).card := by
  classical
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn
    (fun r => (FEI.flipAt r.1 r.2.2, r.2.1)) ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨x, j, k⟩ hr
    simp only [Rec, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] at hr
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rec_mapsTo D hpos i hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, j, k⟩ hr ⟨x', j', k'⟩ hr' heq
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Rec, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] at hr hr'
    obtain ⟨hx, l, hl, hj, hk⟩ := hr
    obtain ⟨hx', l', hl', hj', hk'⟩ := hr'
    have hjj : j = j' := (Prod.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ ▸ heq).2
    subst hjj
    have hy : FEI.flipAt x k = FEI.flipAt x' k' := (Prod.mk.injEq _ _ _ _ ▸ heq).1
    -- the first label is inherited by the common image, so `l = l'`
    have h1 := rec_isFirst_image D hpos i ⟨hx, l, hl, hj, hk⟩ hl hk
    have h2 := rec_isFirst_image D hpos i ⟨hx', l', hl', hj', hk'⟩ hl' hk'
    rw [hy] at h1
    have hll : l = l' := isFirst_unique D h1 h2
    subst hll
    -- `k` is the unique zero of the image inside `V_j ∖ V_l`
    have hxk : x k = true := source_true D hpos ⟨hx, l, hl, hj, hk⟩
    have hxk' : x' k' = true := source_true D hpos ⟨hx', l, hl', hj', hk'⟩
    have hzero : FEI.flipAt x k k = false := by
      rw [FEI.flipAt_self, hxk]; rfl
    have hkk : k = k' := by
      by_contra hne
      have h3 : FEI.flipAt x' k' k = x' k := FEI.flipAt_of_ne hne
      have h4 : x' k = true :=
        (mem_fireSet_iff D hpos x' j).mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj') k
          (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk).1
      rw [hy, h3, h4] at hzero
      simp at hzero
    subst hkk
    have : x = x' := by
      have := congrArg (fun u => FEI.flipAt u k) hy
      simpa [FEI.flipAt_flipAt] using this
    rw [this]

            k ∈ D.V j \ D.V l → FEI.ReadKMoment.IsFirst D (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.fireSet D (FEI.flipAt x k)) l
    theorem rec_isFirst_image (D : Display n s) (hpos : Positive D) (i : Fin n)
    {x : Fin n → Bool} {j : Fin s} {k : Fin n} (h : IsRec D i x j k)
    {l : Fin s} (hl : IsFirst D (D.fireSet x) l)
    (hk : k ∈ D.V j \ D.V l) :
    IsFirst D (D.fireSet (FEI.flipAt x k)) l := by
  classical
  have hxk : x k = true := source_true D hpos h
  have hsub : D.fireSet (FEI.flipAt x k) ⊆ D.fireSet x :=
    fireSet_mono D hpos (flip_le x hxk)
  rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hk
  have hlmem : l ∈ D.fireSet (FEI.flipAt x k) := by
    rw [mem_fireSet_iff D hpos]
    intro m hm
    have hmk : m ≠ k := by rintro rfl; exact hk.2 hm
    rw [FEI.flipAt_of_ne hmk]
    exact (mem_fireSet_iff D hpos x l).mp hl.1 m hm
  exact isFirst_of_subset D hl hsub hlmem

  (f : Finset (Fin s) → ℝ),
  ∑ T with P T, f T * FEI.ReadKMoment.vProb D T =
    FEI.expect fun x => if P (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.fireSet D x) then f (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.fireSet D x) else 0
    lemma sum_vProb_eq (D : Display n s) (P : Finset (Fin s) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] (f : Finset (Fin s) → ℝ) :
    ∑ T ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin s))).filter P, f T * vProb D T
      = FEI.expect (fun x => if P (D.fireSet x) then f (D.fireSet x) else 0) := by

  have hstep : ∀ T : Finset (Fin s), f T * vProb D T
      = (∑ x : Fin n → Bool, (if D.fireSet x = T then f T else 0)) / 2 ^ n := by

    unfold vProb FEI.expect
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by
      by_cases h : D.fireSet x = T
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, mul_one]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, mul_zero])

  unfold FEI.expect
  congr 1

      (if D.fireSet x = T then f T else 0))
    = if P (D.fireSet x) then f (D.fireSet x) else 0
  by_cases h : P (D.fireSet x)
  · rw [if_pos h, Finset.sum_eq_single (D.fireSet x)]
    · rw [if_pos rfl]
    · intro T hT hne

    · intro hc
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩) hc

    exact if_neg (fun hc => h (by rw [hc]; exact hT.2))

    FEI.ReadKRestr.sum_maskWeight_mem · lean/fei_read_k_restriction_reconstruction.lean:152
    Explicit hypotheses and instances (0)

    Read from the elaborated type, including implicit and unnamed assumptions. Ordinary hypotheses describe the theorem’s scope; their presence is not a proof gap.

    No proposition hypotheses or instance parameters.

    Full elaborated type
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) (i : Fin n), (∑ mask, if mask i = Bool.true then FEI.ShortReadKCapture.maskWeight p mask else 0) = p
    lemma sum_maskWeight_mem (p : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ mask : Fin n → Bool, (if mask i = true then maskWeight p mask else 0) = p := by
  classical
  -- the summand is itself a product over coordinates, with `i`'s factor altered
  have hprod : ∀ mask : Fin n → Bool,
      (if mask i = true then maskWeight p mask else 0)
        = ∏ j : Fin n, (if j = i then (if mask j then p else 0)
            else (if mask j then p else 1 - p)) := by
    intro mask
    rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i), if_pos rfl]
    have herase : ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (if j = i then (if mask j then p else 0) else (if mask j then p else 1 - p))
        = ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (if mask j then p else 1 - p) :=
      Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun j hj => by
        rw [if_neg (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1])
    rw [herase]
    unfold maskWeight
    rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    by_cases h : mask i = true
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, if_pos h]
    · have h' : mask i = false := by simpa using h
      rw [if_neg h, h']
      simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun mask _ => hprod mask)]
  have h := Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : Fin n => (Finset.univ : Finset Bool))
      (fun (j : Fin n) (b : Bool) =>
        if j = i then (if b then p else 0) else (if b then p else 1 - p))
  rw [Fintype.piFinset_univ] at h
  rw [← h, Finset.prod_eq_single i]
  · simp [Fintype.sum_bool]
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [hji, Fintype.sum_bool]
  · intro hc
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hc

    Full elaborated type
    ∀ {n s k : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s),
  FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Positive D →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.incident D i).card ≤ k) →
      ∀ {p : ℝ},
        0 < p →
          p < 1 →
            p * (1 - p) ^ (2 * k - 2) * FEI.totalInfluence (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.signOf D) ≤ FEI.ReadKUnate.EIU p D
    theorem capture_k {k : ℕ} (D : Display n s) (hpos : Positive D)
    (hread : ∀ i, (D.incident i).card ≤ k) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    p * (1 - p) ^ (2 * k - 2) * FEI.totalInfluence D.signOf ≤ EIU p D := by
  classical
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - p := by linarith
  have hq1 : (1:ℝ) - p ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hpt : ∀ i : Fin n,
      p * (1 - p) ^ (2 * k - 2) * FEI.influenceOf D.signOf i
      ≤ ∑ mask : Fin n → Bool, maskWeight p mask *
          FEI.expect (fun z : Fin n → Bool =>
            if readOneAt D mask z i then
              FEI.influenceOf (restr (frozen mask) D.signOf z) i else 0) := by
    intro i
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (D.incident i).card with h0 | hpos'
    · -- `i` occurs in no term: it has no influence, and the left side is zero
      have hz : FEI.influenceOf D.signOf i = 0 := by
        refine FEI.SignedRT2.Restrict.orphan_influenceOf_eq_zero (fun j hj => ?_)
        have : j ∈ D.incident i := D.mem_incident.2 hj
        rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.1 h0] at this
        simp at this
      rw [hz, mul_zero]
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun mask _ => ?_)
      refine mul_nonneg (maskWeight_nonneg' hp0.le hp1.le mask) ?_
      refine FEI.WidthBand.expect_nonneg (fun z => ?_)
      by_cases h : readOneAt D mask z i
      · rw [if_pos h]; exact FEI.influenceOf_nonneg _ i
      · rw [if_neg h]
    · have hl4 := FEI.ReadKLemma4.coordinatewise_readk_capture n s D hpos i p
        hpos' hp0 hp1
      refine le_trans ?_ hl4
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (FEI.influenceOf_nonneg _ i)
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hp0.le
      refine pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1 ?_
      have := hread i
      omega
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin n))) => hpt i)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  have hR : ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ mask : Fin n → Bool, maskWeight p mask *
      FEI.expect (fun z : Fin n → Bool =>
        if readOneAt D mask z i then
          FEI.influenceOf (restr (frozen mask) D.signOf z) i else 0)
      = EIU p D := by
    rw [sum_i_weighted]
    unfold EIU
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun mask _ => ?_)
    congr 1
    exact congrArg FEI.expect (funext (fun z => (capturedSet_sum D mask z).symm))
  rw [hR] at hsum
  exact hsum

    theorem child {k : ℕ} (D : Display n s) (hpos : Positive D)
    (hread : ∀ i, (D.incident i).card ≤ k) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :

  have hmono : EH p D

        FEI.influenceOf (restr (frozen mask) D.signOf z) i)
      (fun mask z => FEI.totalInfluence (restr (frozen mask) D.signOf z))

    (hread : ∀ i, (D.incident i).card ≤ k) (mask z : Fin n → Bool) :
    PrivateCore.specEnt (restr (frozen mask) D.signOf z)
      ≤ 8 * (∑ i ∈ capturedSet D mask z,

      exists_minimal_display D hpos (frozen mask) z
    rw [hgdef, hsign₁]
    exact D₁.isBoolean_signOf

      ≤ 8 * (∑ i ∈ U, FEI.influenceOf g i) := by

        ≤ ratio n k * FEI.totalInfluence (restr U g z') := by

    exact hmono
  linarith [htwo, h1, h2]

    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s) (P : Finset (Fin n)) (z : Fin n → Bool) {j : Fin s},
  FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Survives D P z j → ∃ l ∈ FEI.ShortReadKCapture.minimalLabels D P z, D.V l \ P ⊆ D.V j \ P
    theorem exists_minimal_below (D : Display n s) (P : Finset (Fin n))
    (z : Fin n → Bool) {j : Fin s} (hj : Survives D P z j) :
    ∃ l ∈ minimalLabels D P z, D.V l \ P ⊆ D.V j \ P := by

  suffices H : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ j : Fin s, key D P j < N → Survives D P z j →
      ∃ l ∈ minimalLabels D P z, D.V l \ P ⊆ D.V j \ P by
    exact H (key D P j + 1) j (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hj
  intro N

  | zero => intro j hkey _; omega
  | succ N ih =>
      intro j hkey hjs
      by_cases hmin : j ∈ minimalLabels D P z
      · exact ⟨j, hmin, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩
      · have hwit : ∃ l, Survives D P z l ∧ (D.V l \ P ⊆ D.V j \ P) ∧
            (D.V l \ P ≠ D.V j \ P ∨ l < j) := by
          by_contra hc
          refine hmin ?_
          unfold minimalLabels
          exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hjs, hc⟩
        obtain ⟨l, hls, hsub, hne⟩ := hwit
        have hkl : key D P l < key D P j := key_lt D P hsub hne
        obtain ⟨m, hm, hmsub⟩ := ih l (by omega) hls
        exact ⟨m, hm, hmsub.trans hsub⟩

    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s) (P : Finset (Fin n)) {j l : Fin s},
  D.V l \ P ⊆ D.V j \ P → D.V l \ P ≠ D.V j \ P ∨ l < j → FEI.ReadKUnate.key D P l < FEI.ReadKUnate.key D P j
    theorem key_lt (D : Display n s) (P : Finset (Fin n)) {j l : Fin s}
    (hsub : D.V l \ P ⊆ D.V j \ P)
    (hne : D.V l \ P ≠ D.V j \ P ∨ l < j) :
    key D P l < key D P j := by
  classical
  by_cases heq : D.V l \ P = D.V j \ P
  · -- equal shortened supports: the tie-break must be what separates them
    have hlt : l < j := hne.resolve_left (fun h => h heq)
    unfold key
    rw [heq]
    exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hlt _
  · have hcard : (D.V l \ P).card < (D.V j \ P).card :=
      Finset.card_lt_card (lt_of_le_of_ne hsub heq)
    have hls : l.val < s := l.isLt
    unfold key
    calc (D.V l \ P).card * s + l.val
        < (D.V l \ P).card * s + s := by omega
      _ = ((D.V l \ P).card + 1) * s := by ring
      _ ≤ (D.V j \ P).card * s := Nat.mul_le_mul_right s hcard
      _ ≤ (D.V j \ P).card * s + j.val := Nat.le_add_right _ _

  set A : Finset (Fin n → Bool) := Finset.univ.filter (fun c => g c = -1) with hA_def
  have hmem : ∀ c, g c = -1 ↔ c ∈ A := by
    intro c; rw [hA_def]; simp
  have hval := FEI.WidthBand.one_sub_expect_sq hgB hmem
  rw [hval]
  -- the slice is `-1` exactly where nothing fires
  have hslice : ∀ c, g c = -1
      ↔ ¬ (fireSet F (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c)).Nonempty := by
    intro c
    rw [hg_def, hf_def, FEI.PrivateCore.restr, FEI.WidthBand.dnfSign]
    constructor
    · intro h hne
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hne
      by_cases hc : ∀ j : Term F,
          ¬ FEI.WidthBand.Fires (supp F) (pat F) j (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c)
      · exact hc j ((mem_fireSet F _ j).mp hj)
      · rw [if_neg hc] at h; norm_num at h
    · intro h
      have hc : ∀ j : Term F,
          ¬ FEI.WidthBand.Fires (supp F) (pat F) j (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c) := by
        intro j hj
        exact h ⟨j, (mem_fireSet F _ j).mpr hj⟩
      rw [if_pos hc]
  have hp0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (A.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n :=
    div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have hpowpos : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
  have hp1 : (A.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hpowpos]
    have h := Finset.card_le_univ A
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n → Bool) = 2 ^ n := by simp
    rw [hcard] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  by_cases hcase : ∃ j : Term F, j ∉ incidentOn F B
      ∧ FEI.WidthBand.Fires (supp F) (pat F) j z
  · -- a term missing `B` already fires: the slice is constant
    obtain ⟨j, hjnot, hjz⟩ := hcase
    have hAe : A = ∅ := by
      rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      intro c hc
      rw [hA_def, Finset.mem_filter] at hc
      refine (hslice c).mp hc.2 ⟨j, (mem_fireSet F _ j).mpr ?_⟩
      exact (fires_glue_of_not_incidentOn F hjnot z c).mpr hjz
    rw [hAe]
    have hnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ FEI.expect (fun c =>
        if markEvent F B (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c) then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
      refine FEI.WidthBand.expect_nonneg (fun c => ?_)
      by_cases h : markEvent F B (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c) <;> simp [h]
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
    linarith
  · -- nothing outside `B` fires: the mark event is exactly "something fires"
    push_neg at hcase
    have hsub : ∀ c, fireSet F (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c) ⊆ incidentOn F B := by
      intro c j hj
      by_contra hjn
      exact hcase j hjn
        ((fires_glue_of_not_incidentOn F hjn z c).mp ((mem_fireSet F _ j).mp hj))
    have hev : ∀ c, markEvent F B (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c)
        ↔ ¬ (g c = -1) := by
      intro c
      rw [hslice c, not_not]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, hsub c⟩⟩
    have hm : FEI.expect (fun c =>
          if markEvent F B (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c) then (1:ℝ) else 0)
        = 1 - (A.card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n := by
      have hrw : (fun c => if markEvent F B (FEI.PrivateCore.glue Bᶜ z c)
            then (1:ℝ) else 0)
          = fun c => if c ∉ A then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
        funext c
        by_cases h : c ∈ A
        · rw [if_neg (by rw [hev c, not_not]; exact (hmem c).mpr h), if_neg (by simpa using h)]
        · rw [if_pos (by rw [hev c]; intro hc; exact h ((hmem c).mp hc)), if_pos h]
      rw [hrw, expect_indicator (fun c => c ∉ A)]
      have hcompl : (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : Fin n → Bool => c ∉ A)) = Aᶜ := by
        ext c; simp
      rw [hcompl]
      have hcc : (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) = (2:ℝ) ^ n - (A.card : ℝ) := by
        have hcnt := Finset.card_compl A
        have hle : A.card ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n → Bool) := Finset.card_le_univ A
        have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n → Bool) = 2 ^ n := by simp
        rw [hcnt, hcard]
        have hle' : A.card ≤ 2 ^ n := by rw [← hcard]; exact hle
        push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hle']
        ring
      rw [hcc]
      field_simp
    rw [hm]
    nlinarith [hp0, hp1]

/-! ## 3. `lem:random`: reconstruction from a random retention

The note retains each coordinate independently with probability `ρ`.
**Independence is not used anywhere in the proof**, and it is not assumed here.
What the argument needs is exactly two properties of the law of the retained
set: that it is a probability distribution, and that every coordinate survives
with probability `ρ`.  Bernoulli(`ρ`) is one law with those properties; so is
any correlated retention with the same one-coordinate marginal. -/

    ∀ {n s : ℕ} (D : FEI.ShortReadKCapture.Display n s) {k : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (FEI.UnateRT2.Display.incident D i).card ≤ k) →
